newsitem.title: USA: San Francisco bicycle rally turns violent - police.
newsitem.headline: San Francisco bicycle rally turns violent - police.

text.p: At least 30 bicyclists were arrested on Friday after a bicycle rally turned violent, with riders clashing with police and motorists, police reported.
At least two fights broke out between bike riders and motorists, said Sgt. Jill Brophy.
A route through the city was mapped out in advance for the estimated 6,000 bicyclists who took part in the rally, held on the last Friday of each month to promote bicycles as an alternative to cars.
However, bicycle activists veered off the planned route onto busy downtown streets, bringing traffic to a standstill.
"It's totally out of control, a mad house," Sgt. Brophy said.
